Available input files:

<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

# Ensure the outputs directory exists
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)

# Read the input matrix from t11
input_file = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
exclude_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = df[indicator_cols].isna().sum()
total_counts = df[indicator_cols].count()
missing_rates = missing_counts / total_counts

# Determine which indicators to keep (missing_rate <= 0.30)
threshold = 0.30
kept_mask = missing_rates <= threshold

# Create the missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame({
    "indicator": indicator_cols,
    "missing_count": missing_counts,
    "missing_rate": missing_rates,
    "kept": kept_mask
})

# Save the missingness report
missingness_report.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Select the columns to keep: exclude_cols + kept indicator columns
selected_columns = exclude_cols + [col for col in indicator_cols if kept_mask[col]]

# Create the selected matrix with only the kept indicators
selected_matrix = df[selected_columns]

# Save the selected matrix
selected_matrix.to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

print("Processing complete.")
print(f"Total indicators: {len(indicator_cols)}")
print(f"Indicators kept: {kept_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Indicators dropped: {(~kept_mask).sum()}")
</solution_file>
